stable.label: scratch-alife-ci-pass
stable.note: The clean OffscreenCanvas scratch engine and its deeper organism loop now have fresh Codehood and Foundation CI evidence. Deployed browser/iPhone behavior after the ALife change is still unverified.

active_experience.runtime: vanilla JavaScript modules + Worker + transferred OffscreenCanvas; no third-party runtime libraries
simulation_changes: deterministic terrain, shallow-water flow, erosion, sediment, soil moisture/nutrients and structural plants remain active
each crawler has persistent hydration, fatigue, health, stomach contents, lifespan, corpse mass, fear/stress/curiosity and decaying spatial memories
creatures sense food and drinkable water only inside a finite radius and through a terrain line-of-sight approximation
drive arbitration uses persistent intentions for explore, forage, drink, rest and flee rather than changing target every tick
food contact transfers plant biomass into stomach state first; digestion releases energy gradually afterward
drinking requires the simulated mouth point to contact the simulated water surface
walking uses persistent stance feet and planted-foot reaction forces with slower swing/stance cycles
two persistent physical feeler tips are attached to the active head and move from sensor-sweep state
strong water flow increases fear and physically pushes the body
death produces a constrained ragdoll corpse instead of immediately removing the organism
corpse mass decays according to local soil moisture and returns nutrient/moisture to the local substrate
the OffscreenCanvas renderer shows live feeler motion, hydration-dependent body tone and persistent corpses
mobile telemetry exposes current intention, hydration, fatigue and stomach state
approximations: the ALife controller is authored drive arbitration with decaying memory; it is not learning or reinforcement learning
all current crawlers share one morphology and do not yet reproduce or evolve
sensing uses a finite-radius 2D terrain line-of-sight approximation, not optical/acoustic/chemical field simulation
water is a one-dimensional side-view shallow-water approximation rather than 2D/3D Navier-Stokes CFD
creature physics is 2D Verlet/distance-constraint articulation with authored gait actuation, not muscle physiology
stomach digestion is a lumped mass/energy model rather than organ physiology
plant roots remain a reinforcement field rather than explicit root geometry
2.5D depth is presentation ordering rather than full 3D collision
procedural audio remains telemetry sonification rather than acoustic-wave simulation

legacy_ecosystem_stack.note: Previous V100-V110 and patch layers remain in repository history/files for reference but are not imported by the current /genesis-codehood/ page.

active_objective: Exercise the deployed ALife scratch build on iPhone and judge whether movement, drinking, stomach feeding, resting, fear, feeler motion, corpses and pacing read as more lifelike. Improve this clean engine in place based on the device result.
next_gate: LIVE_TESTED and DEVICE_TESTED require actual deployed browser/iPhone execution after this ALife change. CI_PASS alone is not sufficient.
invariants: Active route must not import archived V100-V110 layers
No third-party runtime libraries in the scratch engine
Rendering must run through transferred OffscreenCanvas in the worker
Do not call the drive controller learning
Do not call authored stance gait muscle physiology
Food energy may only rise from stomach digestion after contact ingestion
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
